title: feat: Sprint 2 frontend — login/register validation, dashboard, vehicle UI, a11y, responsive (closes #32 #33 #34 #35 #44 #48 #49)
body:
## Sprint 2 Frontend — Issues #32 #33 #34 #35 #44 #48 #49

This PR delivers Thrupthi-AM476's Sprint 2 frontend assignments on top of all merged teammate work (PRs #51-#55).

### What is implemented

**#32 - Frontend setup**: Vite 5, React 18, React Router 6, AuthContext, ProtectedRoute with redirect-to-origin.

**#33 - Login and registration**: Login has show/hide pw toggle, 403 vs 400 error distinction. Register has real-time pw rule checklist (5 rules), strength bar, confirm-pw field, onBlur validation, submit disabled until all rules met.

**#34 - Customer dashboard and profile**: Dashboard has stat cards with icons, vehicle preview with type icons, active session with time-since. Profile has avatar circle, dirty-state detection on Save, info-list layout.

**#35 - Vehicle management UI**: VehicleForm component with plate regex validation, type icons, aria-labels on action buttons.

**#44 - API integration**: All paths verified against backend. 401 clears localStorage so ProtectedRoute redirects automatically.

**#48 - Responsive and accessibility**: Full design system (Inter font, tokens), skip-to-content, focus-visible outlines, aria-required/describedby/label/busy/live, role=alert on errors, no overflow at 375px.

**#49 - Merge PR**: Branch merged with origin/main. Landing.jsx conflict resolved: teammate's /parking public link preserved.

### Teammate work preserved
- adik1611: RateScheduleService, parking availability, Reservations UI, StaffDashboard
- Vikas75bit: ParkingExit manual ticket entry, test fixes
- Files not touched: App.jsx, Navbar.jsx, ParkingExit.jsx, Reservations.jsx, StaffDashboard.jsx, all backend files

### Test results
```
npm run build   BUILD SUCCESS — 52 modules, 232KB
npm run lint    0 errors, 0 warnings
mvn test        73 tests, 0 failures — BUILD SUCCESS
```

> **Do NOT merge without at least one teammate review.**

Closes #32 #33 #34 #35 #44 #48 #49
